meta¶

Retrieves metadata attributes of an audio stream.

Arguments¶

Name

Type

Description

stream_id

String

ASCII ID of the audio stream.

attribute

String

Name of the metadata attribute to retrieve.

Supported Attributes¶

Attribute

Description

channels

Channel count of the audio stream.

sample_rate

Sample rate of the audio stream (Hz).

bit_depth

Bit depth of the audio stream.

ref

Reference timestamp (milliseconds UTC).

size

Size of uncompressed audio stream in bytes.

Output¶

Type

Description

Integer

Value of the requested metadata attribute.

Example¶

;; SCM expression
(meta "chopin" "channels")

Using EVAL:

EVAL '(meta \"chopin\" \"channels\")'
